title: Track Guide - MX5 - Summit Point Raceway - 1:23.01x

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake hard at the cones on your left, down to second gear
corners.line: aim to apex relatively early, on the inside of the patch of concrete
corners.exit: back on the power early on, watch for the kids who litter on the exit
corners.mistakes: too much throttle on the exit can lead to spinning

corners.label: T3
corners.exit: keep the car to the left and keep it in second gear

corners.spoken_as: for is a hard braking zone
corners.exit: smooth on the throttle on exit

corners.label: T5
corners.line: position your car in the middle of the track and turn into the right-hander
corners.exit: keep the car to the right-hand side of the track

corners.line: turn into this corner in third gear
corners.exit: lift off the throttle to try and stop the car breaking loose
corners.mistakes: keeping your foot on the floor

corners.braking: braking slightly before the dirt on the edge of the track, brake gently
corners.line: point the car to the inside of the track, apex earlier
corners.exit: power down and hook, hold in 4th gear across the line

general_tips: take the inside line around most turns due to the MX-5's low horsepower and low weight
being smooth through this section is key to your lap time
